facts.fact: Mateo 七岁，住在 Testaccio 的旅行者营地一辆锈但干净的拖车里，睡在两个年长手足之间
facts.anchor: In the travellers’ camp at Testaccio, in a rusty but clean caravan, Mateo snores peacefully

facts.fact: Mateo 的梦是铁匠学徒，在锻一枚用来把一个名叫 Yehoshua 的说谎先知钉上十字架的重钉
facts.anchor: he’s been told it’ll be used to crucify a man, a lying prophet named Yehoshua

facts.fact: 作者点明：这个梦取材于几个世纪用来迫害他们族人的故事之一，而 Mateo 在梦里知道这一点却仍继续锤
facts.anchor: Mateo is committing the act that will condemn his people, according to one of the tales that people have been using for centuries to abuse them

facts.fact: 铁在 Mateo 手里不再是钉而是剑，梦自行改了工件
facts.anchor: It’s a sword.

facts.fact: 阴影里凝出的人形只比七岁的 Mateo 高一点，行动却有成年人的自信
facts.anchor: It’s only a little taller than him (and he is only seven years old), yet it moves with the confidence of an adult

facts.fact: 那影子在他耳边低语：去战争，去岛
facts.anchor: “To war,” it whispers in his ear. “To the Island!”

facts.fact: 剑已成，因为梦界的东西直接就是完成态
facts.anchor: The sword is already finished, because in this world that’s how things work

facts.fact: Wedge 在止痛药给的沉睡里睡觉
facts.anchor: Wedge, too, sleeps, in the slumber bestowed by the painkillers

facts.fact: Wedge 在废弃仓库里为躲老鼠跳起，由此知道自己在做梦：清醒时他再也跳不起来
facts.anchor: That’s how he knows that he’s dreaming, because awake he will never be able to jump again

facts.fact: Wedge 的梦审开始：一个持手杖的男人自室深处逼近，雷一般宣布他有罪
facts.anchor: “You are guilty,” thunders a voice. From the back of the room, a man with a cane advances

facts.fact: 持杖者 Augusto Dal Mare 宣称 Wedge 身负「破碎的魔咒」，因此收编他
facts.anchor: You have Broken Enchantment, and I claim you

facts.fact: Augusto 说出 Wedge 身上的伤是谁造的，并骂他是余生连上厕所都得求人的残废
facts.anchor: who has made you what I see. A pathetic cripple who will spend the rest of his life having to beg for help even to get to the toilet

facts.fact: Augusto 排除了激情、复仇、勇气之后，宣布 Wedge 会为恐惧而入伙
facts.anchor: Then you will do it for fear.

facts.fact: 手杖末端的钩离 Wedge 喉头一口呼吸之遥，下一秒就要撕进他体内
facts.anchor: The hook is a breath away from Wedge’s throat, and in another instant it will rip into him.

facts.fact: Giada Speziali 五年前在最愚蠢的一场事故里失去父母
facts.anchor: She lost them five years ago, in the stupidest accident possible

facts.fact: 父亲 Giuseppe 骑摩托载妻子 Lavinia 往城里，几分钟内两人死去
facts.anchor: Giuseppe and Lavinia were heading for the centre, not knowing that within a few minutes they would be dead

facts.fact: 杀死两人的不是摔倒（都戴了头盔），而是碾过来的汽车
facts.anchor: It wasn’t the fall that killed them, but the car that ran them over

facts.fact: 父亲重仓投资，2008 年崩盘赔光，Giada 发现家里一分钱都没有
facts.anchor: her father had heavily invested, and lost everything in the crash of 2008

facts.fact: 撞死他们的是个警察，因此几乎没有赔偿——事故中对方是警察时九成错在死者
facts.anchor: the bastard in the car was a police officer and when you get into an accident with a police officer, nine times out of ten you get the blame even if he kills you

facts.fact: Giada 放弃大学、认清国家不可信、去找工作
facts.anchor: had to give up university, discover that you can’t trust the State, and find a job

facts.fact: 五年后 Giada 住在 Prenestina 一间与旧阳台同尺寸的公寓里
facts.anchor: Five years on, she lives in a flat on the Prenestina

facts.fact: 床下的木箱是祖母遗物，家族破产后所存无几之物
facts.anchor: It belonged to Giada’s grandmother, one of the few things preserved after the wreck of her family

facts.fact: 那块木头有填缝剂的痕迹，说明它曾是船的一部分
facts.anchor: There are traces of caulk

facts.fact: Giada 的第一份工作是罗马垃圾公司 AMA 的清运工
facts.anchor: the first place available was a refuse collector for the AMA, the Roman waste company

facts.fact: Giada 拿礼帽变兔回敬 Wendy 的「迷信」评论，暗指兔子不该凭空出现
facts.anchor: “A lot of people pull rabbits out of hats. Usually they put them in there first, though.”

facts.fact: 羊皮纸上的希伯来文是三个天使名，用来把恶魔 Lilith 挡在children 之外
facts.anchor: it’s Hebrew, and those are the names of three angels: Senoy, Sansenoy, and Semangelof: they’re supposed to keep the demon Lilith away from children

facts.fact: 半截木雕似人而有羊足，形状似乎在动，无法辨认
facts.anchor: it depicts something vaguely human, with goatlike feet, but it’s impossible to make out what, because the bizarre shape seems to keep shifting

facts.fact: Giada 去年夜里看见一只翻垃圾的狗抬头时是五十岁男人的脸
facts.anchor: when it lifted its head to look at me, I swear, it had a human face

facts.fact: Giada 的清单之一：Via Merulana 街中央不该有树木的气味
facts.anchor: Why should there be the smell of trees in the middle of the Via Merulana?

facts.fact: 两天前凌晨清运时，空街上贴着他们响起长笛般的声音
facts.anchor: Just two nights ago, I heard a flute playing, or something like that—I don’t know about music

facts.fact: Wendy 承认自己那顶帽子里的兔子也是怪事之一，她才来求助
facts.anchor: My rabbit isn’t the only strange thing around

facts.fact: 周五夜 Luisa 赌气去睡，这不是她想象中该过的周末
facts.anchor: this wasn’t the weekend she’d been imagining

facts.fact: Giovanni 发现 Luisa 的眼睛不自然，整夜守在自己半边床上，怀疑她是不是别的什么
facts.anchor: Those eyes weren’t natural. He kept to his own side of the bed all night

facts.fact: Giovanni 同意导师换题后反而决定研究 Neverland 而非哈欠
facts.anchor: he needs a subject that really interests him. So he doesn’t work on yawning, but on Neverland

facts.fact: 无名少年临走给 Giovanni 指了 2012 年 11 月《国际心理学期刊》第 23 页的文章
facts.anchor: “International Journal of Psychology, November 2012, article on page 23.”

facts.fact: 少年赤脚走远，一直走到 Giovanni 看不见他
facts.anchor: He walks away, and keeps walking until Giovanni loses sight of him
